_readme: Haspataal MCP Server Configuration — authoritative always-on list
_usage: Copy the mcpServers block into your client config (claude_desktop_config.json, ~/.claude.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, or your global mcp_config.json). Each server carries "alwaysActive": true so the client spins it up on every session.
_context_warning: 11 active MCPs is heavy on your context window. The 'alwaysActive' flag is honored by clients that support it; otherwise the client still loads all listed servers on startup.

serena.description: Serena IDE assistant — semantic code search, navigation, and understanding for the TypeScript/JavaScript codebase. Pulls latest version via --refresh.

context7.description: Upstash Context7 MCP — up-to-date, version-specific library/framework documentation. Configured with the ctx7sk-*** API key.

headroom.description: Headroom AI context management and compression server.

idea-reality.description: Idea and reality mapping server. Verify the exact package name for your environment.

graphify.description: Local knowledge graph server for analyzing codebase relationships. Verify the exact package name for your environment.

supabase.description: Supabase MCP — query tables, run migrations, manage RLS policies, inspect schema.

github.description: GitHub MCP — create PRs, review code, manage issues, search the haspataal repo.

filesystem.description: Filesystem MCP — read/write files in the haspataal project root.

postgres.description: Direct PostgreSQL MCP — run raw SQL, check query plans via EXPLAIN ANALYZE, inspect RLS policies.

memory.description: Persistent memory MCP — store and recall cross-session context and WAR ROOM decisions.

playwright.description: Playwright MCP — browser automation for end-to-end testing and UI verification.

_setup_instructions.step1: Set env vars: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, DATABASE_URL (via .env or shell).
_setup_instructions.step2: Copy the mcpServers block into your client config (global mcp_config.json or project config).
_setup_instructions.step3: All 11 servers carry alwaysActive: true and will spin up on every new session.
_setup_instructions.step4: Verify with your client's MCP list / status command after restart.
